test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Priya buys a mobile phone for her child. The phone is marked at ₹34,400 and is offered with two successive discounts of 13% and Z\% , respectively. After receiving both discounts, she pays ₹22,446. Find the value of Z .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use successive discount multiplier concept

Final Price = MP × (1 − 13/100) × (1 − Z/100)

22446 = 34400 × 0.87 × (1 − Z/100)

22446 = 29928 × (1 − Z/100)

(1 − Z/100) = 22446 ÷ 29928 = 0.75 ⇒ Z = 25

**∴ Answer = 25%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 34400, First discount = 13%, Second discount = Z%

Final Price = 22446

**Formula used:**

Final Price = MP × (1 − d1/100) × (1 − d2/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 22446 = 34400 × (1 − 13/100) × (1 − Z/100)

⇒ 22446 = 34400 × 87/100 × (1 − Z/100)

⇒ 22446 = 29928 × (1 − Z/100)

⇒ (1 − Z/100) = 22446 ÷ 29928

⇒ (1 − Z/100) = 3 ÷ 4

⇒ Z/100 = 1 − 3/4 = 1/4

⇒ Z = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net discount = a + b − (ab/100). For 13% and Z%, net discount can be computed using this formula.

Multiplier Method

Each discount converts into multiplier form: (1 − d/100). Multiply all to get final price.

Equivalent Fraction Trick

If ratio simplifies to common fraction like 3/4, it helps quickly find percentage values.
